content: <thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 235.1395, which corresponds to a protonated molecule [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral mass of ≈ 234.132 Da. A formula that matches this mass within a few mDa and is consistent with the observed M+1 intensity (~16 %) is C₁₄H₁₈O₃ (neutral mass 234.1256 Da, [M+H]+ 235.1329 Da). Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C14H18O3.
